description: This file contains unit tests for the PageStatistics class in the book project. It includes setup methods, test cases verifying the functionality of methods like finding the book with the most pages, calculating average page length, and ensuring correct behavior under edge cases.

classes.name: PageStatisticsTest
classes.description: Test class for PageStatistics, verifying its methods like finding the book with most pages and calculating averages.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by clearing books, populating data, and initializing PageStatistics.

methods.name: findBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Tests if the method correctly identifies the book with the most pages.

methods.name: countOnlyReadBooksTowardsMostPagesStatistics
methods.description: Tests that only books marked as read are considered when determining the book with the most pages.

methods.name: notDivideAveragePageLengthByZero
methods.description: Ensures that calculating the average page length does not result in division by zero when there are no books.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLengthCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies correct calculation of the average page length.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLengthWithFloatPointCalculationCorrectly
methods.description: Checks if floating point calculations for averages are handled correctly.

methods.name: resetPageStatistics
methods.description: Utility method to reset the PageStatistics instance and clear books.
